Dear Duleep,

Try using fill = Year instead of colour in the aes.

Regards,
Jane

On 12 November 2014 08:39, Duleep Samuel <dksa...@gmail.com> wrote:
Dear all
p <- ggplot (data=w, aes(x=Year, y=Yield, color = Year))+ geom_bar(stat="identity")
p + facet_grid(Treatment ~ Centre)+ ggtitle("Comparative Performance of Treatments") +
xlab("Performance over the Time Period") + ylab("Yield(Kg/Ha")

I would like to color the  geom_bar(stat="identity") with 3 different colors / fill, I am unable, please help me, thanks, Dr.D.K.Samuel, IIHR, Bangalore, India
